PC: H&P: Elicits essential information about patient and situation (attends to age, inciting event, signs/symptoms provided); solicits additional basic information such as PMH/medications
H&P: Performs/directs pertinent PE
Monitors: Ensures cardiorespiratory and O2 saturation monitors placed within one minute
Assessment: Assesses airway (looks in, makes sure airway is clear)
Assessment: Assesses breathing (looks for signs of breathing/ chest rise), SpO2
Basic interventions: Performs general airway maneuvers - positions patient (head tilt/ chin lift)
Basic interventions: Provides any oxygen support
Bag-valve mask ventilation: Initiates positive-pressure ventilation in timely manner (within 30 seconds
Bag-valve mask ventilation: Correctly connects to oxygen source
Bag-valve mask ventilation: Bags at appropriate rate (1 breath q 3 seconds)
Bag-valve mask ventilation: Adequate chest rise (seal and bagging technique)
Bag-valve mask ventilation: Confirms efficacy by auscultation or looking at chest wall (self or directs team member)
Basics: Assesses blood pressure (asks/looks for reading)
Basics: Palpates central pulses
CPR: Initiates appropriately (within 10 seconds)
CPR: Correct hand placement (over distal 1/3-1/2 of sternum)
CPR: Correct compression to ventilation rate (15:2), 1/3 depth of chest (~1.5-2 in)
CPR: Time to initiation of CPR less than 1 minute
Arrhythmias: Repeats pulse check after CPR/resuscitation medications (q2 min)
IV access obtained, fluids started, labs drawn
Post-resuscitation care
MK: Arrhythmias: Recognizes presence of abnormal (non-sinus) rhythm on initial presentation
SBP: Management: Performs tasks in appropriate sequence/prioritizes well
ICS: Team leader assigned, assesses situation, gets background, assesses ABC
Recipients understand initial roles and respond/ repeat
Leadership: Communicates effectively with team (asks for help, assesses members of team)
Management: Intermittently summarizes/ maintains global view
PROF: Professionalism: Has professional attitude toward patient
Professionalism: Has professional attitude towards team members
Leadership: Assumes adequate responsibility when in non-leader roles (airway, circulation) (speak-repeat, call back)
